title: The Widow's Lantern
text: A woman as thin as a rake, wrapped in black, stands by a roadside post with a lantern. She has been waiting a long time for someone who went into the Gate. She asks if you have seen him, and describes him exactly.

options.label: The Leader tells her he is coming home, so she may rest at last.

outcomes.text: She smiles, puts out the lantern and goes home. You will not forget her face.

options.label: Tell her the truth: you do not know.

outcomes.text: She nods and keeps the lantern lit, then gives you bread.

options.label: The sharpest promises to look for him, and means it.

outcomes.text: A mile on you find his pack, with a ring in it for her.
